test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the given diagram carefully and answer the question that follows. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of persons who have applied for different posts.

Teacher Engineer Accountant

What is the total number of persons who have applied for more than one post?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/beb3669eac7b0dcbb19d1daf92fd124f46d23c5a3fad0eed9cea07a7e7024876.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0eb07cbecb1a6d737dac09f01f4837e275d15d0d71a0fafb63cd35c9ac5c49f7.png] 

The shaded region represents the total number of persons who have applied for more than one post.

So, the total number of persons who have applied for more than one post = (4 + 6 + 8 + 3) = 21

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
